description:
Hickory Dickory Dock: How Clocks Count Every Single Second! — Hickory dickory dock, the mouse ran up the clock! The clock struck one! But how does a ticking clock know exactly how long a second is?
Kids science answer for "hickory dickory dock rhyme for kids" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Inside old grandfather clocks, a swinging pendulum takes the exact same time on every swing, releasing gears tooth by tooth. Modern clocks use a tiny quartz crystal vibrating 32,768 times every second!

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
